rules.statement: The plaintiff's title is superior despite the defendant's prior registered deed due to the plaintiff's vested legal estate from the date of sale, which is anterior to the defendant's deed.
rules.supporting_quote: At the argument it was conceded that the present case was concluded by the ruling of the Full Court in Aserappa v. Weeratunga et al.; 1 and that the decision of the Commissioner of Requests that the paper title was in the defendant cannot be supported.

meta.parties: Tikiri Banda v. Loku Banda Et Al
